text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: "hosted-inference-slo" (P1) — 5xx spike detected on api-prod. Escalation: primary -> secondary -> manager. PD incident: INC-12345. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-12345

sophie: acked (secondary) — on it, pulling logs and dashboards.

jordan-oncall: got auto-escalation page, primary didn't ack within 3m. I'm switching to bridge in 1m.

tara-sre: seeing 5xx rate ~11–14% over last 4m from hosted inference endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. p95 latency up from 120ms->900ms.

mike: checking infra — some workers showing OOMs and repeated model load errors. suspect quantized model shard eviction on node-gpu-3.

sophie: copying PD payload for context:
```
alert: hosted-inference-slo
service: hosted-inference
trigger: 5xx-rate > 10% for 3m
instances: api-prod-{a,b,c}
metric: requests/5xx per min
value: 12.3%
PD_incident: INC-12345
```

jordan-oncall: joining bridge now — https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-12345 (oncall bridge automated) :rotating_light:

mark-engmgr: I'm being paged as manager (auto-escalation) — will stand by for updates. Can we confirm customer impact and whether any SLA breaches likely?

tara-sre: customer-facing impact: errors returned to clients for generation requests, timeouts on batching. Tentative affected customers: acme-corp (high volume), beta-search. Instrumentation shows retries spiking. No complete account-level downtime yet but degraded.

mike: temp mitigation in progress: disabling model-quantization hot-load on node-gpu-3, draining new requests from that host, and restarting inference worker. Command run:
```bash
ssh gpu-3
sudo systemctl stop inference-worker
rm -f /var/tmp/kvcache/*
sudo systemctl start inference-worker
```

sophie: logs show model load failing with libcudnn error on restart attempts. After initial stop/start, worker came up and started serving, 5xx dropped to ~4% in 90s.

jordan-oncall: routing policy update — shifting 20% traffic off api-prod-a (suspected shard) to dedicated-pool for stability. Applied via traffic-router console.

mark-engmgr: good — please notify CS to tell affected customers we're investigating and mitigating, ETA 30m for full stability.

tara-sre: I'm opening incident ticket INFR-789 in JIRA and marking follow-ups: postmortem, autoscaling review, PD escalation tuning.

mike: confirmation: 5xx now steady at <2% for 10m, p95 latency back to ~150ms. Keeping watch for 15m.

sophie: ack handover: I'll stay as incident lead for the next 30m to validate and start post-incident notes. Jordan, if you need to hand off later ping me.

jordan-oncall: thanks — I'll update pagerduty to mark as acknowledged and add note about manager escalation timed out (primary didn't ack, PD escalated correctly).

mark-engmgr: reaction :thumbsup: Good work. When stable and PD is resolved, please post summary and timeline in #postmortems. Include root cause hypothesis (quant-shard eviction + cudnn model load race) and remediation actions.

tara-sre: adding remediation items now: 1) disable hot quantized load on rolling nodes, 2) add pre-warm model loads after node restarts, 3) PD escalation window tuning to avoid duplicate manager pages for noisy alerts.

mike: creating follow-up runbook entry for gpu OOM recovery and adding automated healthcheck that drains node before reload.

sophie: last check-in: metrics stable for 12m, leaving the bridge in 10m. Marking incident as mitigated in PD once Jordan confirms.

jordan-oncall: closing loop in PD: mitigation applied, monitoring. I'll resolve alert in 20m if no regression.

incident-bot: PD incident INC-12345 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Escalation notes attached.

sophie: thanks team — after we give this a 30m stability window we'll prepare a short incident post with timeline, impact, mitigation, and action items.

mark-engmgr: please @product and @cs to prepare customer comms drafts.

(End of thread)
